text: It is mandatory to file Form 29C- Report under section 115JC of the Income-tax Act, 1961 if AMT tax is more than Normal Tax if not opting for New Tax Regime
If total income under section 115JC as per schedule AMT is less than or equal to Rs. 5000000, surcharge cannot be entered in Schedule B-TTI.
In Schedule VIA, deduction u/s 80JJAA is claimed then Form 10DA is required to be filed.
In Schedule VIA - Part C - Deduction can be claimed only if the original return is filed or being filed on or before the due date specified u/s 139(1).
If assessee claiming relief u/s 90 & 91 then it is mandatory to file Form 67 within the due date allowed u/s 139(1)
If deduction u/s 10AA is claimed in the Income Tax Return then Form 56F should be filed
Deduction u/s 10AA shall be allowed only if return is filed within due date allowed u/s 139(1)
In Part A P&L, tonnage of goods carriage cannot exceed 100MT

Taxpayer having income under the head “Profits and gains of Business or Profession”, Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account has to be filled as required in explanation (d) under section139(9) read with section 44AA.
If audit report u/s 44DA is mentioned then Form 3CE is should be filed.
If assessee is liable to audit u/s 92E then Form 3CEB should be filed.
If assessee is liable to pay AMT u/s 115JC then Form 29C should be filed.
Form 3CFA should be filed within due date to claim the benefits under section 115BBF
Form 10E is required to be filed to claim Relief u/s 89.

If the "Total sales, Turnover or Gross Receipts" is more than Rs.50 Crore, then details regarding "Prescribed Payment Modes under section 269SU" should be provided in e-Filing Portal under "Compliance Module".
Amount can be reduced from schedule BP at Sl.No. A4b i.e. Profit from activities covered under rule 7A, 7B(1), 7B(1A) and 8 only if business code is selected as 1003 , 1002, 1001 respectively
For Resident taxpayers, DTAA benefit is not available, and the claim may not be allowed. Please re-check the claims made. 65
